estimates.assumptions: Modest 'to taste' amount for lemon juice in 1150g total syrup; ~1-2 tbsp realistic for a large batch syrup.
Standard weight for 2 tbsp ground cinnamon is ~13g (6.5g per tbsp).
Standard weight for 1 tbsp ground cardamom is ~6g.
Zest from 1 average orange weighs ~8-10g; using 8g here.
Standard weight for 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ~13g; calories estimated from similar vanilla extracts/pastes (~288 kcal/100g).
Supplied measurement is 500g total filo; using standard filo pastry calorie density of ~299 kcal/100g (raw, as used in recipe).
